sentences.en: You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出，这位建筑师在细节上非常注重。

sentences.en: He is scrupulous in matters of business.
sentences.zh: 他在商业事务上非常谨慎。

sentences.en: Tom is scrupulous in matters of business.
sentences.zh: 汤姆在商业事务上一丝不苟。

senses.zh: 严格认真的，一丝不苟的; 按良心和道德原则办事的;绝对正直的; 有顾忌的，有顾虑的
